summary: Escalation for case-006 (b.cetin@aegean.edu) per Risk Gate (confidence 0.7). F1 is the only unconfirmed signal: sign-in from previously unseen device PH-9900 vs usual device LT-6002 (ATT&CK T1078). Rejected password-spray claims from 78.187.4.44 and 193.140.10.17 are treated as shared-NAT Turkcell background noise, not coordinated spraying. Analyst to verify PH-9900 ownership and MFA enrollment, review sign-in and session logs, force password reset, and disable any suspicious active session. Limitations: model step degraded; travel calendar, EDR endpoint telemetry, and proxy/VPN logs for the source IPs could not be checked.
